Meaning: Every value printed on the page.
Tensile rows: modulus, strengths and elongations of the tensile test.
Flexural rows: flexural modulus and strength.
Impact rows: Charpy, Izod and other impact strengths.
Thermal rows: heat deflection, Vicat, glass transition, melting and service temperatures.
Physical rows: density, melt flow, water absorption and other non-mechanical properties.
